bio: The restaurant of the exclusive Chiemgau Lakeside Retreat, an offshoot of the nearby Resort Das Achental in Grassau, draws you in with its enticing location right on Chiemsee. In fine weather, the lake view is best enjoyed from the terrace, but thanks to the floor-to-ceiling windows, you won't be deprived even if you dine inside. The decor in the dining rooms, which can be separated off by means of a glass partition, is an attractive blend of traditional regional elements such as warm wood and a stylish classic tiled stove and modern sleek lines.
